title: Conduvera GateEvidenceReference v2 (mode-typed EXECUTED|REUSED, card K01)
description: Mode-typed evidence reference: extends the frozen v1 reference by an explicit mode that separates the SOURCE-RECEIPT binding (the EXECUTED fact) from the CONSUMER side. The two concerns are validated as two separately addressable subschemas: source_binding points at exactly one immutable evidence object in the protected store; consumer_context binds the reference to the consuming candidate. Modes never merge: an EXECUTED-mode reference must point at a gate-execution-receipt v1 object, a REUSED-mode reference must point at a gate-evidence-reuse.v1 document; the wrong pairing is rejected. The frozen v1 reference stays untouched beside this additive v2.

evidence_id.description: Fresh id space (gev2_): a v2 reference is never confused with a v1 reference id.

mode.description: EXECUTED: this reference points at a source receipt (fresh execution evidence). REUSED: this reference points at a reuse-evidence document. Never both on one reference.

content_sha256.description: Digest over the canonical content of the referenced evidence payload; proves identity only after the payload is resolved from the store and re-hashed.

store_object_id.description: Object id of the referenced evidence inside the protected store; never a caller-supplied ad-hoc path.

evidence_type.description: GATE_EXECUTION_RECEIPT_V1 is only admissible with mode EXECUTED; GATE_EVIDENCE_REUSE_V1 only with mode REUSED (enforced by the paired if/then rules below).

consumer_tree_sha.description: Tree of the consuming candidate the reference is admitted for.
